build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: flight-authority::input shared intent policy (stick mapping, throttle slew/presets, engine toggle, precision); old pilot adopts free functions, native viewer bundles FlightInput and pushes it into its local authority
ownership.mit: existing render-core frames/instances and render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue unchanged; no game logic moved into MIT crates
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

input_contract.shared_policy: WASDQE stick (S-W, D-A, E-Q), 0.55/s throttle slew clamped 0..=1, cut/full presets, engine toggle, 0.25 precision factor; invalid demands fail closed
input_contract.starter_state: compatibility X-15 arms full legacy throttle with engine on; both clients inherit throttle=1.0/engine=true, so default native runs reproduce the previous trajectory exactly
input_contract.native_mapping: held WASDQE stick rebuilt per frame, Shift/Ctrl slew, X/Z cut/full, Space engine, C cycles Navball->Rate->Direct->MouseAim, T SAS, CapsLock precision; repeats never re-fire presets/toggles; HUD mirrors throttle/engine/precision/SAS plus one-shot law cycle and stick readout in live mode only
input_contract.headless: --throttle 0..=1 and --engine-on preset intent deterministically (rejected without --flight before assets/GPU); no held keys, so explicit presets reproduce the equivalent starter demand bit-for-bit
input_contract.advance_boundary: push runs every rendered frame before the budgeted advance; control law comes from the owned mode (default Navball); stopped flights keep accepting intent like the old client while the advance still stops
input_contract.excluded: RCS/gear/chute part commands, flyby assist, mouse-aim and the mode HUD stay old-client-only

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians on the untouched survey path; no speedup claimed, no adapter tax isolated

runs.name: flight-full
runs.note: explicit presets reproduce the inherited starter demand bit-for-bit: identical final coordinates to the default run, proving the preset path is transparent

live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand incl. owned input push + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated input/renderer cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera cover between orbit/chase; not equal-scene runs and not Bevy parity; trajectory (not pixels) is the cross-mode identity

input_microbenchmark.boundary: stick mapping + slew math and timer/barriers; no devices, authority stepping, ephemeris, assets, streaming, GPU work or waits

verification.new_regressions: shared stick table/cancellation, slew factors/clamps/convergence, presets/toggles/precision, invalid-demand no-op, old-client Bevy-key wiring, intent staging vs authority adoption, mode cycling, SAS control, 600-step pushed-vs-direct trajectory identity with cut-glide divergence, telemetry keys, --throttle/--engine-on/help CLI validation, full-thrust preset window lifecycle
verification.review: local input ownership, factor exactness, preset transparency, survey workload preservation, held-key/discrete boundaries and GPL/MIT separation

native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame
actual local authority at 10.5s with the owned input panel (100% throttle, engine ON, ATTITUDE HOLD, centered stick)
explicit --throttle 1 --engine-on presets; identical trajectory to the inherited starter demand
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot on shared input factors; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not equal-scene parity

limitations: Local diagnostic flight host only: no native network/fleet receive loop, prediction/reconciliation, part commands (RCS/gear/chute), flyby/mouse-aim assists, production flight UI or full client lifecycle replacement.
Survey/map camera still legacy; materials remain base-color/Lambert without PBR/shadows/atmosphere parity.
Captures are not visual acceptance or equal-scene Bevy parity.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
